route_gate.mechanism: App.tsx mounts /ticket-center with requireInternal={!isPartnerDevReach('/ticket-center')}. isPartnerDevReach(path, devBuild = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV)) is true only when devBuild is true and the path is in PARTNER_DEV_REACH_PATHS (only /ticket-center). isPathAllowedForFirm grants a known partner firm (a FIRM_ALLOWED_PATHS key) this path only when isPartnerDevReach holds. Internal (opal-capital) callers are unchanged (always true). Unknown or null firms stay denied.
route_gate.what_the_flag_grants: The vite dev server (import.meta.env.DEV true): a known partner firm reaches /ticket-center and sees the partner view. A production bundle (vite build; import.meta.env.DEV false): the set grants nothing and requireInternal stays true. The gate is the build flag, not the per-user userType Dev claim (the candidate's own comment, firmAccess.ts, explains why requiresDev cannot keep PROD refusing a partner).
route_gate.not_granted_by_this_stack: The served list is not server-scoped by this stack: listTickets has no firm parameter (measured at a577cba5, surprise IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W103-S3).
